title: Close the proved-findings audit campaign
objective: Finish fix/audit-proved-findings by reusing the field registry and the pinned defusedxml parser, hoisting the constant document-rule search, and proving the result on the pinned test fixture. A write of different values per record stays, because one write cannot carry those values.
success_criteria: scripts/audit/odoo_audit.py describes the same rule it enforces: an unresolved view emits nothing, and depends and onchange checks use the same inherit registry as constraints

A write inside a loop is a finding only when every item would receive the same values; a write of different values per item is not a finding, and plasticos_enrichment/models/enrichment_run.py is not rewritten to hide those writes
cron_check_missing_docs searches plasticos.document.rule once, before the transaction loop, with the same domain
Every repository XML parse named in this plan imports defusedxml.ElementTree and the nosec marker on that parse is gone
tests/test_cron_xml_lock.py and tests/cron_contract.py are on fix/audit-proved-findings, and the lock test imports defusedxml.ElementTree
run_baseline_gate.sh reports no new CRITICAL or HIGH finding and the three proved types stay absent from both baseline files
The pinned Docker test fixture runs the tests of every plasticos module whose Python behavior changed, and make update of those modules runs only when that worktree is the tree Docker mounts

in: scripts/audit/odoo_audit.py docstring, depends check, and onchange check
scripts/audit/performance_audit.py identical-values write rule and its unit tests

Stdlib XML parses in tools/cron_invariant_check.py, tests/test_xpath_anchor_topology.py, tests/test_odoo19_compat.py, ci/check_xpath_stability.py, ci/check_state_guard_bypass.py, ci/check_automation_field_refs.py
Copy of the two untracked cron files from the main checkout onto this branch
Fixture tests and a mount-checked module upgrade of the modules already bumped on this branch
out: 27 unbounded searches and 19 unjustified sudo calls; they are a later campaign
CRM roadmap README failure and VanillaSoft phantom enums on the other branch
A batch write helper or a nested function whose only job is to hide enrichment profile writes
A new test-database template or a second Docker Compose project
Any other dirty file in the main checkout
ci and tools parsers beyond the six named XML entry points

pre_validation.pass_criteria: The bound tree is the worktree, not the CRM worktree and not the dirty main checkout

pre_validation.command_or_action: python3 .cursor-commands/ops/hooks/plan_memory_prefetch.py --workspace the main checkout --task the close-out objective
Name .pre-commit-config.yaml as the hook catalog for the governed checkout
pre_validation.pass_criteria: Catalog named; no origin/main lock and no new worktree requirement

todos.task: Make the field and query scanners describe and enforce one rule: inherit fields are visible to depends and onchange, unresolved views stay silent, and a loop write is a finding only when the values are identical
todos.shared_root_cause: file-scoped checks and a lexical loop rule that cannot see identical writes

todos.task: Parse repository XML with the pinned defusedxml parser, delete the nosec markers on those calls, and copy the two cron lock files onto the branch
todos.shared_root_cause: stdlib XML parse hidden by nosec

todos.task: Search plasticos.document.rule once before the missing-document transaction loop, keeping the current domain
Rescan, run the scanner and cron tests, and run fixture tests for every module whose Python behavior changed
Upgrade the already bumped modules only when Docker mounts this worktree
todos.anchor: make update m= the bumped module list

milestones.outcome: Scanners and the document-rule hoist match the proved-finding rule
Repository XML parses use defusedxml and the cron lock files are on the branch
Baseline gate and fixture tests pass

checkpoints.evidence_required: Field attribution tests and n-plus-one tests pass, including an identical-values write finding and a differing-values write that is silent
checkpoints.no_go_action: Stop. Do not allowlist the new finding and do not wrap the enrichment write

checkpoints.evidence_required: rg finds no xml.etree.ElementTree import in the six named files, and the cron lock test passes on the worktree
checkpoints.no_go_action: Stop. Do not add a nosec marker

checkpoints.evidence_required: run_baseline_gate.sh prints no audit baseline regression, and make test-module for the changed modules passes on the pinned fixture
checkpoints.no_go_action: Stop the upgrade. Fix the failing module before make update

doc_root_surface_impact.reason: No addon count, command, or CI contract change. The scanner docstring inside scripts/audit/odoo_audit.py is the surface that must match the code.

disconfirming_questions: Does extending depends and onchange to inherit fields create a new gated finding that the plan would silence with a baseline row?
Does defusedxml reject repository XML that the stdlib parser accepted?
Can the enrichment profile merge become one write without dropping per-profile values?
Does make update from this worktree change a database whose compose project mounts the dirty main checkout?
assumed_false_ifs: A nosec comment is an acceptable close for a stdlib XML parse
A nested helper that only hides a write closes an N+1 finding
The uncommitted manifest bumps must be bumped again before the first upgrade
The main checkout's other dirty files belong on this branch
stress_test.blast_radius: A wrong inherit-field check can hide a real missing field or fail the baseline gate. A wrong Docker mount can upgrade the wrong tree. A rejected XML parse stops the cron and CI parsers that read repository XML.
stress_test.rollback: The branch is uncommitted. Restore the worktree with git checkout -- on the touched paths and remove the two copied cron files if they were the only additions. Do not reset the dirty main checkout.

shared_causes: Field checks that still see only the first _name in a file
Stdlib XML parsing concealed by nosec
A search whose domain does not change inside a loop
Distinct per-record writes treated as a missing batch API
deletions_or_consolidations: Delete the nosec B314 markers on the named XML parses
Delete the per-transaction document-rule search by hoisting it
Delete the docstring sentences that still call unresolved views a gated finding
Do not add a write wrapper in plasticos_enrichment

risks.risk: Inherit-aware depends or onchange checks emit a new proved finding
risks.mitigation: Fix the missing field or the registry. Do not add a baseline row to go green.

risks.risk: defusedxml rejects a local XML file the stdlib parser accepted
risks.mitigation: That rejection is the closed behavior for entity expansion. Repair the XML if it is a real document; do not switch the parser back.

risks.risk: Docker Compose for the live database mounts the main checkout
risks.mitigation: Probe the mount before make update. Run fixture tests from the worktree either way. Do not start a second compose project.

unknowns.question: Which directory does the running Docker Compose project mount as /mnt/extra-addons?
unknowns.decision_effect: make update runs only when that directory is the wt-audit-truth worktree. Otherwise the upgrade stays blocked and the fixture tests are the runtime proof.

In wt-audit-truth: make test-module for each plasticos module whose Python behavior changed, on the database named in config/test_env_fixture.conf

final_validation.pass_criteria: Hooks pass for the touched files

convergence.stop_reason: Architecture is selected and the plan is validated. Implementation starts when Build is pressed. U1 is probed before the upgrade and does not block the code edits.

ci/baselines except to refuse a new allowlist row

make update lists only the modules whose manifests already changed on this branch
Publication is make pr into Staging
validation_commands: make test-module for each changed plasticos module
pre-commit run on the touched paths
